capability_advanced: Trusted crate-internal General configuration now works on an ordinary Native runtime without replacing its permanent unscoped Host/Registry acquisition services. Each admitted command owns one fresh finite scope on the same persistent bank; original physical data cannot be reminted under a later scope. Two actual original cquery commands and actual bootstrap/payload cancellation use this path. Default CLI policy stays Disabled.

compatibility.exact_inherited: No new Bazel parity surface. Existing pinned Bazel9.2 repository API/source contracts and admitted process/REAPI behavior remain inherited. No Bazel oracle invocation was needed for this Slug-native ownership/lifetime change.
compatibility.slug_native: Finite command clocks, exact token/Arc/bank origin identity, persistent native credit admission and read-only data lifetime are Slug-native. Work<=27s and cleanup<=3s remain existing finite policy; fresh command does not refresh old data authority.
compatibility.unsupported_deferred: Default production activation; complete immutable/Builtin/Local source bridges; cross-root links; full archive envelope; original-route physical CAS/runfiles/restoration; public authentic Rust; equivalent-command memory and full bootstrap remain unproved.

ownership: WorkspaceRuntime.source_scope and RegistryIo installation remain fixed acquisition ownership: Native=None, Diagnostic=its original Arc. The trusted non-test configure_general_repository_workspaces boundary is crate-internal and tests call it through a thin helper; no CLI/environment/caller/source selector activates it.

Busy is decided before scope allocation. A fresh credited command scope is created once, bound to the exact actor token before preflight, and retained across Need/replay attempts. Diagnostic borrows its original Arc and never refreshes it. No mutable runtime current-scope slot or native owner is injected into DICE.

Fresh scope control plus every live buffer/decoder reservation additionally debits the SAME persistent RepositoryRootResources bank. Per-scope counters and ceilings stay unchanged; shared-bank refusal is sticky Allocation with no failed counter/peak increments. Old reservations constrain later admission until actual drop. Conservative double charges are retained; no new bank, global cache, interner, dependency or cap increase.

Native actor binding rejects an uncredited fresh scope, foreign workspace/scope or bank. General operations authenticate current token and exact Arc. Existing Host/Registry acquisition keeps its old counters, byte policy and None scope; command future supervision is a separate lifetime bound.

Physical builders bind original scope at actual construction and sealed roots transfer the same Arc. Reader/open/observe/image and native source wrapper construction check exact original identity. Data retains no mount-domain authority. Existing image pins retain original scope during image IO; B cannot renew A by metadata reauthentication or passing B scope.

General comparisons, selected data leases, physical batch snapshots and image factories use token-bound command scope. Complete batch validation/prepayment precedes IO; original scope and current row/request/result associations are checked after IO. Adoption rechecks borrowed general.scope under the existing actor guard, without recursive actor locking.

Owned fresh Native commands supervise the entire DICE attempt and cancellation/idle drain under the original work/cleanup clocks. Fixed Diagnostic keeps its existing acquisition timer provenance. Args stop contexts and native source/action-chain transport wrappers use current command scope, including pending work that never opens a reader.

Accept drains DICE/native/result custody and checks current scope before consuming the actor token; successful immutable data leases retain A original clock. Abort sticky-cancels only its owned fresh scope, drops the attempt, drains and retires actual native custody before canonical prior-snapshot injection/discard/close. Cleanup failure keeps Open/Busy, with no early refund or cleanup-success claim; later actual retirement may release credits. No timer proves termination of blocked kernel/Host/Registry service work.
